title: Tines story review findings
description: The contract /tines-review emits and review.yml passes to --json-schema (the @file form is VERIFY, docs/VERIFY.md #21 - inline the schema if it fails). verdict must be changes_requested when any finding has severity blocker or major. path is stories/<slug>/story.json#<action name>, stories/<slug>/story.meta.yaml, or tines-skills/<name>/SKILL.md. rule is a lint rule id from policies/lint-rules.yml or a checklist letter from /tines-review. Fixes to a story go through /mcp, so suggested_prompt is a ready /tines-build-story invocation, never an edit to the export.

verdict.description: pass only when no finding is blocker or major

findings.description: Empty when the review found nothing; ordered blocker first

path.description: stories/<slug>/story.json#<action name> | stories/<slug>/story.meta.yaml | stories/<slug>/tests/<file> | tines-skills/<name>/SKILL.md | policies/<file>

rule.description: A rule id from policies/lint-rules.yml (for example http_retry_bounds, agent_output_schema_required, monitoring_required_for_prod, tools_are_requests) or a /tines-review checklist letter a-m, or self-review / one-story-per-pr

severity.description: blocker = must not merge; major = must be fixed or explained before merge; minor = fix soon; info = observation

message.description: One sentence stating the defect. Never contains a credential value, a token or an email address

suggested_fix.description: What to change, in plain words

suggested_prompt.description: A ready /tines-build-story <slug> "<prompt>" that would fix it; present whenever the fix is a story change

cost_notes.description: Credit observations: new AI Agent actions, tool counts, schedule intervals, provider, budget line present or missing
